technical.title: RaMOD detects moving objects from raw mmWave radar cubes under ego motion
technical.summary: RaMOD is a real-time framework that processes raw range-azimuth-Doppler cubes from a single-chip radar to perform moving-object detection and velocity estimation despite ego-motion and Doppler wrapping.
technical.why: It bypasses sparse point cloud reductions to extract richer velocity data directly from raw radar signals.

technical.title: EarthRecord benchmark evaluates multimodal agents on four decades of satellite imagery
technical.summary: EarthRecord is a new benchmark featuring raw data from 56 sites spanning four decades of multi-sensor satellite archives. It tests multimodal agents on 238 land-change questions across ten analysis tasks, requiring agents to handle cloud masking and cross-sensor harmonization.
technical.why: It provides a rigorous way to evaluate how well multimodal vision agents can perform raw satellite data analysis.

technical.title: GEMOR-GS refines 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM with global extrinsic calibration
technical.summary: GEMOR-GS introduces global extrinsic-calibration-refined mapping and online relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM systems to produce geometrically accurate, photorealistic world representations for robots.
technical.why: It improves the metrical accuracy and re-enterability of Gaussian maps for continuous robot operation.

technical.title: MBZUAI releases PAN 2, an open 29B world model for physical AI
technical.summary: MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models released PAN 2 under Apache 2.0. The 29B diffusion transformer couples with an LLM planner to simulate up to 20 seconds of action outcomes as video.
technical.why: It gives physical AI researchers an open large-scale world model for video-based action simulation.

technical.title: Deletion Tuning matches full fine-tuning by zeroing a tiny fraction of weights
technical.summary: Deletion Tuning learns a binary mask over transformer gate projections, zeroing fewer than 0.05% of weights. This matches full fine-tuning performance across various post-training regimes while reducing checkpoint size and catastrophic forgetting.
technical.why: It provides a highly efficient alternative to full fine-tuning for continual learning and model adaptation.

technical.title: URL-Sim improves LiDAR simulation for dynamic autonomous driving scenes
technical.summary: URL-Sim addresses limitations in existing 3D Gaussian Splatting-based LiDAR simulators by targeting high-fidelity reconstruction and regulated rendering for dynamic driving logs, aiming for cost-effective safety validation.
technical.why: It offers better synthetic LiDAR data generation tools for validating autonomous driving pipelines.

technical.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 enhances robot dexterity, reliability, and safety
technical.summary: Google's updated vision-language-action model improves general robot dexterity, reliability, and safety for real-world manipulation tasks.
technical.why: It represents a progression in applying foundation models directly to robotic hardware control.

technical.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
technical.summary: Developers can now deploy the 120B-parameter NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL multimodal model in SageMaker JumpStart using NVFP4 or BF16 variants for document intelligence, computer use, and agentic workflows.
technical.why: It makes a massive open multimodal model easily accessible for scalable enterprise cloud deployment.

technical.title: AlphaProof Code agents write millions of lines of proofs to verify encryption
technical.summary: AlphaProof Code agents successfully wrote three million lines of formal proofs in the Lean theorem prover to verify Signal's core encryption protocol.
technical.why: It demonstrates the practical utility of automated reasoning agents in verifying complex software systems.

technical.title: Maze Runner open autonomy stack demonstrates robust robot navigation in simulation
technical.summary: Maze Runner is an open C++ and ROS 2 autonomy stack for maze navigation. It uses 2D LiDAR, RANSAC line extraction, and Extended Kalman Filters to handle localization, mapping, and planning in narrow corridors.
technical.why: It offers an end-to-end open-source reference for lidar-based robot localization and mapping pipelines.

business.title: Data center backlash in Virginia highlights rising electricity concerns
business.summary: A visit to Ashburn, Virginia, the world's largest data center hub, reveals that growing public backlash against data centers is fundamentally driven by electricity consumption.
business.why: Power constraints directly threaten the physical scaling of AI infrastructure and data center expansion.

business.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range to target $1.404 trillion valuation
business.summary: Anthropic set an IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share, which could result in a fully diluted implied valuation of up to $1.404 trillion.
business.why: Massive market capitalizations for foundation model builders dictate compute purchasing power and industry economics.

business.title: Anthropic seeks record $88.5B in IPO and private placement
business.summary: Anthropic submitted an updated S-1 filing seeking up to $88.5 billion in its planned IPO and concurrent private placement, marking a potentially historic public debut fundraise.
business.why: This represents the largest capital injection into an AI lab, altering industry investment scales.

business.title: Nvidia shares rebound 5% amid scrutiny of Jensen Huang
business.summary: Nvidia shares rebounded 5% as investors assess whether CEO Jensen Huang's affair will have spillover effects on the company's business operations.
business.why: Executive stability at hardware monopoly Nvidia directly impacts the broader AI infrastructure market.

business.title: Anthropic opens Australian retail IPO offering ahead of debut
business.summary: Anthropic opened its Australia retail IPO offering on Wednesday, allowing individual investors to apply for shares ahead of its planned public market debut.
business.why: Public offerings from leading foundation model labs set valuation benchmarks for the entire AI industry.

business.title: Anthropic confirms target valuation up to $1.4 trillion for IPO
business.summary: Anthropic confirmed its upcoming IPO with a share price range between $70.00 and $78.00, placing its potential market valuation as high as $1.4 trillion.
business.why: It establishes a major valuation milestone for the generative AI sector.

business.title: Ukraine fiber-optic drones squeezed by AI data center demand
business.summary: Ukraine is facing supply squeezes for China's optical fiber, competing directly against Russia and massive AI data center construction demands.
business.why: Global AI infrastructure buildouts are creating supply chain bottlenecks that impact unrelated critical tech sectors.

business.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces scrutiny amid US AI dominance
business.summary: As Nvidia controls the critical hardware fueling the AI boom, CEO Jensen Huang faces intense personal scrutiny that could affect the company leading the US AI race.
business.why: Nvidia's market dominance is closely tied to its leadership stability and strategic positioning.

business.title: ChatGPT launches beta for verified AI Business Agents
business.summary: ChatGPT is introducing verified Business Agents in beta, allowing e-commerce and online service brands in the US to represent themselves and assist users with tasks like comparison shopping.
business.why: It expands conversational AI utility into agentic enterprise commerce applications.

business.title: Oura to acquire Counsel Health for $625M after pausing IPO
business.summary: Oura is acquiring AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625 million. The acquisition follows Oura's decision to indefinitely postpone its up to $2.2 billion IPO due to market uncertainty.
business.why: It highlights strategic M&A moves by prominent hardware and health tech players amid a constrained IPO market.
